documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Appointment of Statutory Auditor/s
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Premier Polyfilm Limited reported robust financial performance for FY 2025-2026, with net profit surging to 3,188 lakhs and revenue reaching 34,126 lakhs. Production volume grew to 29,311 metric tonnes driven by enhanced capacity utilization. Management highlighted strategic cost and margin management, including procuring raw materials at competitive prices and discontinuing sub-optimal product lines. Additionally, the company secured an industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park for logistics and trading activities and placed an order for manufacturing machines. Premier Polyfilm Limited published its annual report for the fiscal year, detailing administrative matters such as the notice of the 33rd Annual General Meeting, adoption of financial statements, and retirement and re-appointment of directors and auditors.

demand_outlook.claim: The company focused on high-demand, high-profitability categories by strategically discontinuing product lines with sub-optimal margins.
demand_outlook.quote: This was complemented by the strategic discontinuation of product lines with sub-optimal margins, allowing for a concentrated focus on high-demand, high-profitability categories.

capex_expansion.claim: The company secured and took possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and commenced logistics and trading activities.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has secured and taken possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and that the Company has commenced logistics and trading activities at the new unit and the billing process has also started.

capex_expansion.claim: The company placed an order for manufacturing of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine, with advance payment made.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company has placed an order for manufacturing of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine and the advance payment for the same has been made.

margins_costs.claim: The company implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.
margins_costs.quote: The Company successfully implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.

margins_costs.claim: The company reduced finance costs by arranging cheaper loans from Yes Bank Limited.
margins_costs.quote: Secondly productions of some of the items of finished goods which were not generated good profits were stopped and to some extent company could arrange cheaper loan from other bank i.e. Yes Bank Limited and hence finance cost was also reduced.

margins_costs.claim: Lower profitability in the company was attributed to economic slowdown and adverse market conditions.
margins_costs.quote: Due to economic slowdown and consequent adverse market conditions prevailing, there was lower profitability in the Company.

margins_costs.claim: Increased cash profit was mainly due to arranging raw materials at cheaper rates and selling finished goods at existing sales prices without devaluing them.
margins_costs.quote: The reasons for increase in cash profit during the current quarter and year ended on 31st March,2024 was mainly due to that company could arrange raw material at cheaper rate and sold the finished goods at existing sales prices i.e. the prices of finished goods were not changed/devalued.

orders_capacity.claim: Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products grew to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational excellence was a key highlight, with production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products growing to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.

orders_capacity.claim: The production volume increase is a direct result of enhanced capacity utilization following the successful commissioning of new plant and machinery during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: This increase is a direct result of enhanced capacity utilization following the successful commissioning of new plant and machinery during the year, which has strengthened our manufacturing capabilities.

orders_capacity.claim: The company produced 27,133 M.T. of PVC flooring, sheetings, films etc. during the period under review compared to 26,755 M.T. in the previous year.
orders_capacity.quote: During the period under review your company produced 27,133 M.T. of PVC flooring, Sheetings, Films etc. as against 26,755 M.T. produced during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Higher capacity utilization was achieved with the installation and utilization of new plant and machinery.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company achieved higher capacity utilization with the installation and utilization of new Plant & Machinery.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended the payment of a dividend of 15% (Rs. 0.15 per equity share of Rs. 1/-) for the financial year 2025-2026.
capital_allocation.quote: “RESOLVED THAT a dividend of 15% (Rs.0.15 per equity share of Rs. 1/-) as recommended by the Board of Directors be and is hereby declared out of the profits of the Company for the financial year 2025-2026.”

capital_allocation.claim: The Board transferred an amount of Rs. 400/- Lakh to General Reserves during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board has transferred an amount of Rs. 400/- Lakh to General Reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 15% amounting to Rs. 0.75 per equity share of Rs. 5 each for the year ended March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: Encouraged by the performance of the company, The Board of your company is pleased to recommend for your approval Payment of dividend @ 0.75 per equity share of Rs.5/- each (i.e. 15%) for the year ended on 31st March,2024 subject to deduction of Tax at Source

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not accept any money in the form of unsecured loans from directors and/or their relatives during the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the company has not accepted money in the form of Unsecured Loan from any of the Directors and/ or their relative(s).

capital_allocation.claim: Unpaid or unclaimed dividend for FY 2015-16 amounting to Rs. 4,11,273 and 5,66,435 equity shares were transferred to the IEPF.
capital_allocation.quote: During the FY 2023-24, unpaid/ unclaimed dividend for the FY 2015-16 aggregating to Rs.4,11,273/- and 5,66,435 numbers of equity shares of nominal value of Rs. 28,32,175/- for which dividend entitlements remained unpaid/ unclaimed for seven consecutive years or more, were transferred by the Company to IEPF established by the Central Government

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved the sub-division of existing equity shares of the company from a face value of Rs. 5 per share to Rs. 1 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors at their meeting held on 17th May, 2024 considered and approved the proposal of restructuring the Share Capital of the Company by sub-dividing the existing equity shares into face value of Rs. 1/- per share in place of Rs. 5/- per share.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted material and commitments affecting the financial position of the company include steep fluctuations in the prices of raw material.
risks_headwinds.quote: There were no material changes and commitments affecting the financial position of the company between the end of financial yearto which these financial statements relate and as on the date of this Report except steep fluctuations in the prices of raw material as discussed elsewhere in this report.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company received a notice from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited regarding delay in uploading Related Party Transaction disclosures, resulting in a fine.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the year under review, the Company received a notice from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) regarding non-compliance with the provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) due to delay in uploading the Integrated Filing (XBRL) containing Related Party Transaction disclosures under Regulation 23(9) of the SEBI Listing Regulations on the NEAPS portal.

risks_headwinds.claim: Lower profitability in the company was experienced due to an economic slowdown and adverse market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to economic slowdown and consequent adverse market conditions prevailing, there was lower profitability in the Company.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production through the newly ordered PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.
management_commitments.quote: The commercial production through the said machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to fully switch to sustainable and renewable sources of power such as solar and PNG energy in addition to current sources during the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Seeing the Government inclination towards pollution free environment and as per various notifications of Government in this regard,your Company plans to fully switch other sustainable and renewable sources of power/energy such as Solar and PNG energy inaddition to available current source of power energy available with the company during the current financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
